_meta.notes: Provincial overtime thresholds for the Canadian markets TempGuru serves. Overtime thresholds are statutory employment-standards values (stable law). Provincial minimum wages change frequently and are intentionally NOT stored: the coordinator confirms wage floors on every Canadian quote. Operational guidance, not legal advice.
_meta.source: Provincial employment standards legislation (Ontario ESA, BC ESA, Alberta ESC, Quebec LSA, and equivalents), cross-checked July 2026.

ON.name: Ontario
unique_rules: Most event roles are covered by ESA hours-of-work and eating-period rules

BC.name: British Columbia
unique_rules: Daily overtime after 8 hours (1.5x); double time after 12 hours/day

AB.name: Alberta
unique_rules: Overtime after 8 hours/day or 44 hours/week, whichever is greater

QC.name: Quebec
unique_rules: French-language requirements (Bill 96) can apply to postings, contracts, and signage

SK.name: Saskatchewan
unique_rules: Overtime after 8 hours/day (10 in a modified work arrangement) or 40 hours/week

NB.name: New Brunswick
unique_rules: Overtime after 44 hours/week (overtime floor is 1.5x the minimum wage)

NL.name: Newfoundland and Labrador
unique_rules: Overtime after 40 hours/week (overtime floor is 1.5x the minimum wage)
